498deb27760e13c94835fc6216f930bfbb3bdff7.statement: No payment creates or loses money.
498deb27760e13c94835fc6216f930bfbb3bdff7.formula:
(∀ (x : Payment), (∀ (x_1 : World), (match (pay x x_1) with | (x_2, x_3) => ((Payments.total x_3.books) = (Payments.total x_1.books)))))

@[frflow_defs] def total (x : Ledger) : Int :=
  (List.foldl (fun (x_1 : Int) (x_2 : Account) => (x_1 + x_2.balance)) (0 : Int) x.accounts)

95638f1ddbb3bd0edc37a2338afa1728e89be377.statement: No payment takes a balance below zero.
95638f1ddbb3bd0edc37a2338afa1728e89be377.formula:
(∀ (x : Payment), (∀ (x_1 : World), (match (pay x x_1) with | (x_2, x_3) => ((Payments.noneNegative x_1.books) → (Payments.noneNegative x_3.books)))))

@[frflow_defs] def noneNegative (x : Ledger) : Prop :=
  (∀ x_1 ∈ x.accounts, ((0 : Int) ≤ x_1.balance))

8bcac592988675c5d08c7e481ed80d0b00199996.statement: A payment not asked by the owner of the account it is from changes nothing.
8bcac592988675c5d08c7e481ed80d0b00199996.formula:
(∀ (x : Payment), (∀ (x_1 : World), (match (pay x x_1) with | (x_2, x_3) => ((¬(Payments.owns x_1.books x.«by» x.«from»)) → (x_3.books = x_1.books)))))

@[frflow_defs] def owns (x : Ledger) (x_1 : String) (x_2 : String) : Prop :=
  (∃ x_3 ∈ x.accounts, ((x_3.id_ = x_2) ∧ (x_3.owner = x_1)))

      !Ledger.owns(books.current, p.by, p.from) implies (books.in(pay(p).after) === books.current))

cb0f013cd58a6184b6c24ddebba991e97ac3a2c8.statement: A payment changes no balance but those of its two accounts.
cb0f013cd58a6184b6c24ddebba991e97ac3a2c8.formula:
(∀ (x : Payment), (∀ (x_1 : String), (∀ (x_2 : World), (match (pay x x_2) with | (x_3, x_4) => (((¬(x_1 = x.«from»)) ∧ (¬(x_1 = x.to))) → ((Payments.balanceOf x_4.books x_1) = (Payments.balanceOf x_2.books x_1)))))))

@[frflow_defs] def balanceOf (x : Ledger) (x_1 : String) : Int :=
  (List.foldl (fun (x_2 : Int) (x_3 : Account) => (if (x_3.id_ = x_1) then (x_2 + x_3.balance) else x_2)) (0 : Int) x.accounts)

forall((p: Term[Payment], id: Term[String]) => (id =!= p.from && id =!= p.to) implies
      (Ledger.balanceOf(books.in(pay(p).after), id) === Ledger.balanceOf(books.current, id)))

8690e5fdcc341844305324e71f128aeef1fde870.statement: A payable payment is made: its amount moves to the other account, and it is recorded as paid.
8690e5fdcc341844305324e71f128aeef1fde870.formula:
(∀ (x : Payment), (∀ (x_1 : World), (match (pay x x_1) with | (x_2, x_3) => ((Payments.payable x_1.books x) → (Payments.made x_1.books x_3.books x)))))

@[frflow_defs] def payable (x : Ledger) (x_1 : Payment) : Prop :=
  ((((((Payments.owns x x_1.«by» x_1.«from») ∧ ((0 : Int) < x_1.amount)) ∧ (x_1.amount ≤ (Payments.balanceOf x x_1.«from»))) ∧ (¬(x_1.to = x_1.«from»))) ∧ (Payments.hasAccount x x_1.to)) ∧ (¬(Payments.hasPaid x x_1.id_)))

@[frflow_defs] def owns (x : Ledger) (x_1 : String) (x_2 : String) : Prop :=
  (∃ x_3 ∈ x.accounts, ((x_3.id_ = x_2) ∧ (x_3.owner = x_1)))

@[frflow_defs] def balanceOf (x : Ledger) (x_1 : String) : Int :=
  (List.foldl (fun (x_2 : Int) (x_3 : Account) => (if (x_3.id_ = x_1) then (x_2 + x_3.balance) else x_2)) (0 : Int) x.accounts)

@[frflow_defs] def hasAccount (x : Ledger) (x_1 : String) : Prop :=
  (∃ x_2 ∈ x.accounts, (x_2.id_ = x_1))

@[frflow_defs] def hasPaid (x : Ledger) (x_1 : String) : Prop :=
  (x_1 ∈ x.paid)

@[frflow_defs] def made (x : Ledger) (x_1 : Ledger) (x_2 : Payment) : Prop :=
  ((((Payments.balanceOf x_1 x_2.«from») = ((Payments.balanceOf x x_2.«from») - x_2.amount)) ∧ ((Payments.balanceOf x_1 x_2.to) = ((Payments.balanceOf x x_2.to) + x_2.amount))) ∧ (Payments.hasPaid x_1 x_2.id_))

forall((p: Term[Payment]) =>
      Ledger.payable(books.current, p) implies Ledger.made(books.current, books.in(pay(p).after), p))
